findings.finding: The phrase evidence pack names three different layers. E1 public evidence is reference-only, E1 private evidence contains calibrated values, and the frozen E3 model view deliberately combines approved private values with references. Documentation must not say either that the LLM receives only hashes or that private values are publicly exposed.

Fit/confirmation references, relation-binding hash, units, and support/consistency/effect summaries are bound upstream but are not serialized in the frozen real ConstructionInputViewV1. The project verifier can recover upstream authority from RealConstructionEvidenceV1, but the model-visible pack itself is not a full human-readable provenance record.

ConstructionInputViewV1 protects semantic metadata with an exact-key denylist rather than a schema-closed metadata vocabulary. The frozen real adapter is safe because it hard-codes exactly three benign metadata fields; a future adapter should preserve that closure rather than relying only on the denylist.

The public E1 cohort reports 42 relations, 462 numeric bindings, no candidate-origin filtering, no scientific ranking, no rule generation and no runtime authority. It is construction input authority, not validity, runtime or utility authority.
Frozen construction-result artifacts show construction acceptance only and explicitly leave utility untested; the evidence pack contains no basis for detection-performance claims.

unknowns: Units are not explicit in the model-visible construction view and were not inferred from private values.
Support, consistency and effect summaries are not visible in the frozen construction view; this audit does not infer that the LLM received them through hashes.
No private numeric payload was opened, printed or independently compared by this audit.
This lane did not determine arm-level parser/verifier/runtime-authorization semantics; those belong to Agents B-D and ARCH-005.

recommended_official_wording.evidence_pack: The frozen construction input binds one confirmed normal delayed-response relation to approved calibrated values and references. The LLM-facing main-arm view includes those approved values and references, but excludes raw HAI rows, labels, test/utility outcomes, candidate-arm results and runtime authority.
recommended_official_wording.numeric_authority: The LLM may reason over approved calibrated values but must return approved references; it is not the numeric authority.
recommended_official_wording.claim_boundary: Construction evidence and proposal acceptance do not establish runtime authorization or detection utility.
